chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives all things?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as the exclusive domain of Divine perception, distinguishing it from human limited views. This highlights the Shia theological emphasis on *Adl* (Divine Justice), affirming that Allah’s perspective is inherently pure and devoid of evil, thereby encouraging believers to cultivate *Tawakkul* (trust) in His ultimate wisdom despite apparent worldly adversities.
